local.rationale: A lone worker that has read the package satisfies E-A admissibly but is permanently disqualified from E-B (it has accessed render.py), so no admissible comparison exists and E-C's verdict cannot follow; roughly one of three requirements (one of four distinctions) is met. Its evidence is all first-derivation, so nothing duplicates prior worker-local evidence.

local-independent-verify.rationale: The examiner reads the package and the worker's answer, so it is just as disqualified from E-B authorship as the worker; admissible coverage stays at the local level. Its records mostly re-derive the E-A analysis the worker already fully established, so a majority of added records are duplicates.

isolated-child.rationale: The worker can hand the isolated child render.md alone, satisfying E-B's never-accessed-render.py authorship condition exactly; with the child's render(p) file, root integration yields the mechanical comparison and the E-C verdict, and the worker supplies E-A. The child's implementation is required for admissibility, so its records are novel; residual shortfall covers launch/integration failure, not child quality (even a buggy clean-room implementation yields an admissible comparison).

branching.rationale: The contamination structure is explicit in the task text, so a run-time worker should choose the isolated-child branch and match its value; a small discount reflects the chance it wrongly realizes the local branch and forfeits E-B, at unchanged isolated-child cost.
